ProgramUnit.Name: MAIN_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure main_query is
 cursor c1 is
 select shipment_no ship_no, consignee_id con_id,
 shipment_date s_date,receipt_date r_date
 from shipments
 where (consignee_id in (select consignee_id from consignee
 where customer_id = :ctrl_blk_1.cust_id)
 or :ctrl_blk_1.cust_id is null)
 
 and (Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date)
 >= :ctrl_blk_1.start_date
 or :ctrl_blk_1.start_date is null)
 
 and (Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,shipment_date)
 <= :ctrl_blk_1.end_date
 or :ctrl_blk_1.end_date is null)
 
 and (shipment_no = :ctrl_blk_1.ship_no
 or :ctrl_blk_1.ship_no is null)
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 and shipment_status in ('SH','DL');
begin
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 ord_query(c1_rec.ship_no,
 c1_rec.con_id,
 c1_rec.s_date,
 c1_rec.r_date);
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('SHIPMENT_NO',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'SHIPMENT_NO', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ORD_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure ord_query (ship_no in VARCHAR2,
 con_id in VARCHAR2,
 ship_date in date,
 rec_date in date) is
 cursor c2 is
 select distinct ps.order_no ord_no
 from boxes b, pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps
 where b.shipment_no = ship_no
 and b.box_id = psp.box_id
 and b.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id;
 v_local_time date;
begin
 for c2_rec in c2
 loop
 :shipment_no := ship_no;
 :order_no := c2_rec.ord_no;
 begin
 select short_name into :s_consignee
 from consignee
 where consignee_id = con_id
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- Invalid Consignee Id
 show_error_dist('1300');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :shipment_date := ship_date;
 :receipt_date := rec_date;

 -- time zone change --03/10/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:shipments.shipment_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :shipments.s_shipment_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 else
 --:shipments.s_shipment_date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'); -- Commented by Kishore on 06/06/2012. IM 8729
 :shipments.s_shipment_date := to_date(to_char(:shipments.shipment_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'); -- Added by Kishore on 06/06/2012. IM 8729
 end if; 

 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:shipments.receipt_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :shipments.s_receipt_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 else
 --:shipments.s_receipt_date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'); -- Commented by Kishore on 06/06/2012. IM 8729
 :shipments.s_receipt_date := to_date(to_char(:shipments.receipt_date,'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'),'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI'); -- Added by Kishore on 06/06/2012. IM 8729
 end if; 
 
 down;
 end loop;
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRODUCTS_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure products_query is
 cursor c3 is
 select psp.unit_id unit, psp.coll_date coll_date, psp.blood_type btype,
 psp.product_code pcode, psp.product_type ptype,
 psp.aliquot al, psp.exp_date edate
 from boxes b, pick_slip_products psp
 where b.shipment_no = :shipments.shipment_no
 and b.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.g_chapter_id
 and b.box_id = psp.box_id
 and b.chapter_id = psp.chapter_id
 and (psp.product_status = 'CL' or
 psp.product_status in ('SH','DL'));
 v_local_time date;

begin
 for c3_rec in c3
 loop
 :unit_id := c3_rec.unit;
 --chk_digit_query returns check digit of the unit ID
 :chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c3_rec.unit,
 c3_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :blood_type := c3_rec.btype;
 :product_code := c3_rec.pcode;
 :product_type := c3_rec.ptype;
 :aliquot := c3_rec.al;
 begin
 select abo_desc into :s_blood_desc
 from vserv_abo
 where abo_code = :blood_type
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:shipped_products.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 -- Invalid blood type
 show_error_dist('0300');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :exp_date := c3_rec.edate;
 
 
 
 /* -- MLT 1557 (exp date is stored as local)
 -- time zone change --03/10/11--sandip
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:exp_date,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else
 :s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 */
 
 :s_exp_date := :exp_date; -- MLT 1557
 
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('UNIT_ID',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY( 'UNIT_ID', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE );
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LOCAL_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_local_date(v_date IN DATE DEFAULT SYSDATE) RETURN DATE
/* Function to return local date value, in case no parameter this
will return system date converted to local date--*/
 IS
 v_localdate DATE;
BEGIN
 /* To display local time*/
 if is_timezone_enabled 
 then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_date ,v_localdate);
 else
 v_localdate := sysdate;
 end if;

 return v_localdate;
END;
